scope: Independent branch-only zero-evaluator preflight. Literal runtime/environment, event, child-process and file stubs only. The helper imports only current non-policy diagnostic helpers; historical bytes are read and parsed, never imported or executed. No measurement admission, fixture construction, policy evaluation, game or broad test discovery.
cases: R01 sanitized environment accepts only PYTHONHASHSEED=0 and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; literal PYTHONPATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH and LD_PRELOAD are rejected
R02 parent runtime preflight records unlimited initial address space, installs exact512MiB and rechecks the actual runtime without mutating test process limits
R03 literal unexpected inherited parent address-space cap blocks before setrlimit
R04 fresh-child runtime mode requires inherited exact512MiB and never resets limits
R05 runtime mismatch propagates and blocks before spawning or running stub tests
R06 spawned runtime child uses the same resolved executable, exact -B -s, sanitized environment and explicit child-only command; mocked child proof is verified
R07 child nonzero startup including literal missing libpython loader error is retained and fails closed, without retry or sanitation change
R08 child successful exit with absent, corrupt, wrong-PID, wrong-parent or runtime-mismatched proof is rejected using finite literal JSON files
R09 fixed test module allowlist exactly matches checked test paths; no discovery, unlisted test or historical import is allowed
R10 static checks hash/AST-parse current source, verify protocol and historical blob/constructor identities without restoring or importing historical modules
R11 changed checked-source bytes after focused stub tests cause preflight failure
R12 failed or skipped explicit stub-test result cannot produce success; fixed passing result preserves preparation-only zero-call metadata

R13 workflow static contract gates repository, owner, exact branch, main SHA and only opened/synchronize/reopened; pinned setup-python, sanitation, resolved executable and failure log retention are present
R14 parent main failure writes preparation-only execution_blocked report preserving completed phases; no admission or measurement command is reachable

execution_rule: Record this plan before any execution. Parent owns the combined test pass. These fourteen cases use mocks or static parsing only and spawn no real runtime or evaluator processes. Runner preflight later executes the fixed approved existing stub modules plus this module, once per matching PR event; it must expose rather than repair a sanitized pinned-interpreter startup failure. No change to the exact runtime, sanitation, measurement caps or canonical routine test.yml is authorized.
